title: Human-docs dependency registry
description: DOCSUP-01 shape contract for the PARSED form of docs/doc-dependencies.toml — the registry of source-set -> human-authored-doc review obligations. Constrains SHAPE ONLY. The five DOCSUP-01 semantic rejections (path escape, duplicate id across rows, empty selector on a required binding, derived/reference target, accepted-ADR edit policy) are NOT expressible in JSON Schema — they need cross-row uniqueness, a live filesystem, and glob-set membership — and are enforced by tools.docs_guard.registry, which is the registry's ONLY validator (the registry is TOML, so /contract-check's check-jsonschema step does not cover it). Self-contained Draft 2020-12 — no cross-file $ref.

binding.description: The [[binding]] rows. Absent or empty is a shape-valid registry.

severity.description: Exactly these 2 values. 'required' bindings fail the guard when stale; 'advisory' bindings warn.

disposition.description: All four disposition spellings live in ONE enum. The accepted-ADR restriction — a docs/adr/** target may declare only REVIEWED_STILL_CURRENT and SUPERSEDING_ADR_REQUIRED, never 'updated', because accepted ADRs are append-only / supersede-don't-edit — is a CROSS-FIELD policy that depends on glob-matching the sibling 'target' value, so it cannot be expressed here. tools.docs_guard.registry enforces it. Do NOT 'tighten' this enum: splitting it would make an ADR-track row unrepresentable in the general case.

id.description: Stable kebab-case binding identifier, referenced by the review ledger. Uniqueness ACROSS rows is not expressible in JSON Schema (uniqueItems compares whole objects, not one field); tools.docs_guard.registry runs the duplicate-id scan.

sources.description: Repo-relative POSIX selectors whose content changes create the review obligation. minItems is deliberately NOT set here: DOCSUP-01 requires the empty-selector rejection to be CONDITIONAL on severity == 'required', and an unconditional minItems would make an advisory row with no sources unrepresentable rather than merely warned. tools.docs_guard.registry applies the conditional rule, and also performs the path-escape rejection (absolute or '..' segment), which needs the live filesystem.

target.description: Exactly one human-authored target document (not an array). The derived/reference-target rejection tests membership in tools.adoption_scan.destinations.DERIVED_GLOBS — a glob-set test against a live tree — and is enforced by tools.docs_guard.registry, not here.

dispositions.description: The disposition vocabulary this binding admits. Which subset is legal for a given target is policy, not shape — see $defs/disposition.
